attempts.summary: On node1, created the datauser account and a dedicated 512MB loopback-mounted XFS filesystem at /srv/data (backed by /var/lib/srv-data.img, persisted in /etc/fstab with loop,uquota options). Set an XFS user quota of 100MB (soft=hard=100m) for datauser via xfs_quota, so the limit is enforced natively by the filesystem's kernel-level quota subsystem rather than any application logic. Verified enforcement both before and after a full node reboot (writes past 100MB fail with "Disk quota exceeded"; writes under the limit succeed). Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and quota/data state, issued systemctl reboot, polled until node1 reconnected, confirmed boot_id changed, and confirmed /srv/data auto-remounted with quota intact and data preserved.
